title: Caterpillar has expanded its range of hydraulic excavators by introducing seven new models in the 11 to 20 tonne category, complementing their existing lineup of larger models. This brings their total to 12 models, showcasing versatility with options for different booms, sticks, and attachments tailored for various tasks. The excavators feature advanced hydraulic systems with variable displacement pumps for enhanced performance and fuel efficiency. Additionally, the wheel models incorporate cutting-edge technology for improved maneuverability and stability on job sites, making them suitable for a wide range of excavation tasks.
